work.name: University of Michigan, Department of Biostatistics

Clean, process, and analyze high-dimensional lipidomics data, perform exploratory analysis and visualization, and collaborate with nephrologists at the Medical School under the guidance of Dr. Peter Song.

Reviewed study designs and performed power analyses, hypothesis testing, and descriptive statistics using R and REDCap.
